issues.description: Attribute 'lectureName' has conflicting types between the problem statement UML and the reference implementation. In problem_statement.md (UML) the field is declared as 'lectureName: int' (line 64). In the solution (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) the field is declared as 'private String lectureName;' (line 6). This mismatch will confuse students about which data type to implement for lectureName and may lead to constructor/signature mismatches or failing tests if they follow the UML instead of the intended String type.
issues.suggestedFix: Correct the UML in problem_statement.md so 'lectureName' is declared as a String (e.g. change 'lectureName: int' to 'lectureName: String'). Ensure any textual descriptions or examples in the problem statement that mention lectureName also reflect it as a String so students implement the attribute and constructor with the expected type.
